setup.title: Welcome to Inkpact
setup.intro: Create the administrator account for this installation.
setup.codeHint: Shown in the server log when Inkpact starts.
setup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A few random words work well.

errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password is not right.
errors.setup_code_invalid: That setup code is not right. Look for it in the server log.
errors.setup_not_available: This installation has already been set up. Sign in instead.
errors.display_name_invalid: Enter your name, up to 200 characters.
errors.workspace_name_invalid: Enter a name for the workspace, up to 200 characters.
errors.password_too_short: The password needs at least 12 characters.
errors.password_too_long: The password can be at most 128 characters.
errors.password_same_as_email: The password cannot be your email address.
errors.network_error: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.server_error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment.
errors.login_locked: Too many wrong passwords for this account. Try again {when}.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many attempts from this device. Try again {when}.
errors.too_many_pages: Too many pages are open at once. Close one and try again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.csrf_invalid: The page was out of date. Reload it and try again.
errors.title_invalid: The title can be at most 500 characters.
errors.parent_invalid: That page cannot be used as a parent.
errors.parent_in_trash: That page is in the trash.
errors.position_invalid: That place is no longer valid. The pages have been refreshed.
errors.move_cycle: A page cannot be moved below itself.
errors.page_in_trash: That page is in the trash. Restore it first.
errors.restore_the_parent: Restore the page above it first.
errors.attachment_too_large: That file is too large to add.
errors.attachment_not_added: Some files could not be added: the page closed, became read-only, or the place for them was deleted.
errors.import_invalid: That is not a Joplin export. In Joplin desktop, choose File, Export all, JEX.
errors.import_too_large: That file is too large to import.
errors.import_in_progress: An import is already running in this workspace. Wait until it has finished.
errors.import_too_many_items: The export holds more items than can be imported at once.
errors.sidecar_unavailable: The part of the server that builds the pages is not available. Try again in a moment; what was imported is kept.
errors.import_failed: The import stopped because something went wrong on the server.
errors.interrupted: The import was interrupted, because the server restarted.
errors.workspace_missing: The workspace this import was for no longer exists.

shell.loadFailed: The pages could not be loaded.

moveDialog.title: Move “{title}” to
moveDialog.description: Choose the page it should go under. It becomes the last page there.

trash.title: Trash
trash.intro: Pages you moved to the trash. Restoring a page brings back everything below it.

status.offline: Offline · changes are kept in this tab

sync.tooLarge: This change is too large to save. Reloading the page discards it.

editor.label: Page content
editor.newerVersion: This page was made with a newer version of Inkpact. Reload the page to keep editing.

file.label: File
file.description: Attach a file from your device

page.notFound: This page could not be found
page.inTrash: This page is in the trash.
page.inTrashThroughParent: A page above this one is in the trash.

start.title: Welcome
start.empty: You have no pages yet. Create your first one.
start.pick: Pick a page in the sidebar, or create a new one.

import.title: Import from Joplin
import.intro: Bring your notes over from Joplin. Notebooks become pages with the same nesting, and notes keep their text, images, files, tags, to-dos and dates.
import.viewerOnly: You can only read this workspace, so you cannot import into it.

export.title: First, export your notes from Joplin
export.step1: In Joplin desktop, choose File, Export all, and then JEX - Joplin Export File.
export.step2: Export with the notes decrypted. Notes that are still encrypted in the file are skipped.
export.step3: Choose the .jex file below. A large export can take a few minutes.
export.again: Importing the same file again adds nothing twice: what is already here is left alone.

upload.title: Uploading {name}
upload.label: Upload progress
upload.leaveConfirm: The upload is not finished. Leave this page and stop it?

import.connectionLost: Lost contact with the server. Trying again…
import.showRunning: Show the import that is running

running.title: Importing {name}
running.label: Import progress
running.queued: Waiting for the import to start…
running.leave: You can leave this page. The import carries on, and this address shows how it went.

done.title: The import has finished
done.titleWithNotes: The import has finished, with some things to look at

failed.title: The import stopped
failed.keep: What was imported before it stopped is kept. Importing the same file again carries on where it stopped, and adds nothing twice.

left.alreadyImported: {count} item was already imported earlier and was left alone. | {count} items were already imported earlier and were left alone.
left.alreadyInTrash: {count} item imported earlier is in the trash here and was left there. | {count} items imported earlier are in the trash here and were left there.
left.trashed: {count} note was in Joplin’s trash and was not imported. | {count} notes were in Joplin’s trash and were not imported.
left.skipped: {count} item was skipped. | {count} items were skipped.
left.failed: {count} item could not be imported. | {count} items could not be imported.
left.unlisted: {count} more line is not listed below. | {count} more lines are not listed below.

report.title: What to look at
report.empty: Everything came across as it was.
report.intro: {count} item was skipped or did not come across exactly as it was. | {count} items were skipped or did not come across exactly as they were.

reasons.unknown: Something did not come across as it was.
reasons.unsupported_element: The “{detail}” element is not supported. Its text was kept.
reasons.removed_element: The “{detail}” element was removed, with what was inside it.
reasons.link_removed: A link was removed because its address ({detail}) is not allowed. Its text was kept.
reasons.link_removed_relative: A link with a relative address was removed. Its text was kept.
reasons.note_link_pending: A link to another Joplin note became plain text. Links between notes come in a later version.
reasons.resource_missing: A picture or file that this note uses is not in the export. Its text was kept.
reasons.resource_link_text_lost: The text of a link to a file was replaced by the file’s name.
reasons.external_image: An image from another site became a link to its address.
reasons.image_not_kept: An image could not be kept. Its description was kept.
reasons.footnote: Footnotes are not supported. Their text was kept.
reasons.definition_list: Definition lists are not supported. Their text was kept.
reasons.math: Math is not supported. The formula was kept as text.
reasons.highlight: Highlighting is not supported. The text was kept.
reasons.sub_superscript: Subscript and superscript are not supported. The text was kept.
reasons.mermaid: A Mermaid diagram was kept as a code block.
reasons.nesting_flattened: Content nested too deeply was flattened.
reasons.mark_dropped: Formatting that cannot go with a link was dropped. The link was kept.
reasons.truncated: Something was too long and was cut off.
reasons.encrypted: It is encrypted in the export, so it was skipped. Export from Joplin desktop with the notes decrypted.
reasons.item_too_large: It is too large to import and was skipped.
reasons.resource_too_large: The file “{detail}” is too large to attach and was left out.
reasons.resource_empty: The file “{detail}” is empty and was left out.
reasons.notebook_missing: Its notebook is not in the export, so it was put at the top level.
reasons.notebook_cycle: Its notebook was inside itself, so it was put at the top level.
reasons.notebook_in_trash: Its notebook is in the trash. Restore the notebook and import again.
reasons.parent_failed: Its notebook could not be imported, so this was not imported either.
reasons.conversion_failed: Its content could not be converted. This is a fault in Inkpact, not in your note.
reasons.item_failed: Something went wrong while importing it. The server log has the details.

notices.restoredToTopLevel: “{title}” was restored to the top level, because the page it was in is gone.
